title: H_1 of the naive cotangent complex commutes with localization
statement: Let $R\to A$ be a homomorphism of commutative rings, $T\subseteq A$ a multiplicative subset and $B=T^{-1}A$ the ring of fractions [def-weil-pbc-module-localization], an $R$-algebra through $R\to A\to B$, $\lambda:A\to B$, $a\mapsto a/1$. Let $\gamma_A:R[A]\to A$ and $\gamma_B:R[B]\to B$ be the canonical presentations with kernels $I_A$, $I_B$, and $H_1(L_{A/R})\subseteq I_A/I_A^2$, $H_1(L_{B/R})\subseteq I_B/I_B^2$ the first homologies of the naive cotangent complexes [def-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map]. The $R$-algebra map $\varphi:R[A]\to R[B]$, $[a]\mapsto[\lambda(a)]$ ($R[\,\cdot\,]$ the polynomial ring [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring]) satisfies $\gamma_B\circ\varphi=\lambda\circ\gamma_A$, hence $\varphi(I_A)\subseteq I_B$, and $g\bmod I_A^2\mapsto\varphi(g)\bmod I_B^2$ restricts to an $A$-linear map $h:H_1(L_{A/R})\to H_1(L_{B/R})$. Then $h$ is a localization of the $A$-module $H_1(L_{A/R})$ at $T$: the $B$-linear map $T^{-1}H_1(L_{A/R})\to H_1(L_{B/R})$, $x/t\mapsto(1/t)\,h(x)$, is an isomorphism of $B$-modules.
